stories.title: Pope Leo XIV to leave hospital Saturday after lung cancer surgery
stories.summary: The Vatican said Pope Leo XIV will be discharged from Rome's Gemelli Hospital on Saturday, days after surgery for lung cancer. The pontiff's recovery has renewed scrutiny of how candid the Vatican is about papal health.

stories.title: Oregon teacher fought school attacker before armed dad killed suspect
stories.summary: An Oregon teacher threw her phone and tackled a teenage gunman who opened fire on a special educational needs class in Bend, before an armed parent shot the suspect multiple times, police said. Bend's police chief credited the interveners with preventing a worse toll.

stories.title: Trump waives several Russian sanctions as new US law takes effect
stories.summary: President Trump signed a new Russia sanctions bill but waived several of its provisions, saying the waiver is in the US national interest, as his row with Ukraine's Volodymyr Zelensky intensifies. Lawmakers urged the law's full implementation.

stories.title: Houthis strike Yemen's Aden
stories.summary: Iran-backed Houthi forces struck Yemen's southern city of Aden, widening their fight with the internationally recognised government. The attack comes as government forces press an offensive against the Houthis.

stories.title: Is MCP becoming the foundation of decentralised search?
stories.summary: An article circulating on Hacker News argues that the Model Context Protocol is emerging as a common layer for AI agents to query decentralised search services, rather than every vendor building custom integrations. Standardisation would speed up agent adoption while concentrating influence over the spec.

stories.title: DeepSeek ships v4.1 Flash 1017 model
stories.summary: DeepSeek released its v4.1 Flash 1017 model, which hit the front page of Hacker News with links to OpenRouter and Hugging Face. It continues the rapid cadence of cheap, fast Chinese models pressuring US AI labs on price.

stories.title: Mark Wahlberg takes on longevity startups with budget gyms
stories.summary: Mark Wahlberg is launching an affordable gym concept aimed at the longevity-startup crowd, pitching low-cost fitness against expensive biohacking clinics. The move shows celebrity brands pushing further into the longevity market.

stories.title: States sue OpenAI, saying ChatGPT hurts children and deceives adults
stories.summary: A group of US states sued OpenAI, alleging that ChatGPT harms children and misleads adults about its risks. It is the latest legal front over how AI products affect minors.

stories.title: Cleveland Browns news: injuries dominate the headlines
stories.summary: Dawgs By Nature's Saturday roundup leads with Cleveland's injury situation and the Deshaun Watson debate over holding the ball too long, a day before the Browns host Baltimore. The AFC North game is a chance for Cleveland to steady a struggling offense.

stories.title: Week 6 picks: no one believes in Cleveland against Baltimore
stories.summary: Analysts are overwhelmingly picking the Ravens to beat the Browns in Sunday's AFC North matchup in Cleveland. The consensus reflects how little faith predictors have in the Browns' offense.

stories.title: Ravens rule out Lamar Jackson; Tyler Huntley to start against Browns
stories.summary: Baltimore ruled out quarterback Lamar Jackson (ankle) for a second straight game, so Tyler Huntley starts Sunday against the Browns. Huntley faces a Cleveland defense coached by Todd Monken, Baltimore's former offensive coordinator.

stories.title: Indiana Skull Session: Get Dumped Then, Hoosiers
stories.summary: Eleven Warriors' game-day Skull Session sets the tone for Ohio State's top-five matchup with Indiana, blending injury notes, playoff stakes and bulletin-board material. It is the staff's last word before kickoff.

stories.title: Connelly breaks down loaded Week 7, headlined by Ohio State-Indiana
stories.summary: ESPN's Bill Connelly previews Week 7, with Ohio State's top-five meeting with Indiana among the marquee games alongside Notre Dame-BYU. The stakes extend to the wider playoff picture.

stories.title: Is Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith the best WR college football has ever seen?
stories.summary: ESPN debated whether Ohio State's Jeremiah Smith is the greatest receiver in college football history as the Buckeyes prepare for Indiana. The argument underlines how dominant Smith has been in Columbus.

stories.title: Ohio State injury report: Siereveld, Ja'Kobi Jackson out; Brock Boyd doubtful
stories.summary: Ohio State ruled out Austin Siereveld and Ja'Kobi Jackson and listed Brock Boyd doubtful for Saturday's top-five showdown with Indiana. The absences test the Buckeyes' depth against the Hoosiers.

stories.title: Zak Brown warns Norris and Piastri after Singapore collision
stories.summary: McLaren CEO Zak Brown gave a stern warning to Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri after their Singapore sprint collision, telling his drivers not to repeat the contact. McLaren is protecting its position with both drivers fighting for wins.

stories.title: Christian Horner calls for F1 budget cap rethink
stories.summary: Christian Horner called for a rethink of Formula 1's budget cap, claiming teams are spending $500-600m, well beyond the cost-cap figure. His comments land as the sport debates financial rules for the next regulatory era.

stories.title: Mercedes F1 accounts reveal £633m revenue and £125m shareholder payout
stories.summary: Newly filed accounts for Mercedes' F1 operation show £633m in revenue and a £125m payout to shareholders. The figures underline the commercial scale of the sport's leading teams.

stories.title: Ferrari expected to bring new floor to United States GP
stories.summary: Ferrari is expected to introduce a new floor at the United States Grand Prix in Austin as part of its final major upgrade of the 2026 season. The goal is similar or greater downforce with a less stiff set-up, widening the car's operating window.

stories.title: Pedestrian dead after being hit by vehicle in Brewery District
stories.summary: One person died after being struck by a vehicle while crossing the street in Columbus's Brewery District on Friday night, police said. The collision closed part of the district just south of downtown during the overnight hours.

stories.title: Two Ohio airmen killed in World War II laid to rest this month
stories.summary: Two Ohio airmen killed in World War II are being laid to rest this month, with services in central Ohio. The burials bring long-awaited closure to their families.

stories.title: Twenty One Pilots fans take over Columbus for Ohio Stadium show
stories.summary: Twenty One Pilots play a sold-out hometown show at Ohio Stadium on Saturday night, drawing tens of thousands of fans to Columbus. Fans lined up early, singing and swapping friendship bracelets near campus.

stories.title: Columbus restaurant closed by car crash lands on Yelp 2026 best list
stories.summary: A Columbus restaurant temporarily closed after a car crashed into it still made Yelp's 2026 best-restaurants list. The listing is a bright spot for the business as it deals with the damage.
